assumptions: Exhibited on a declared-synthetic control edge. It shows the REPRESENTATION is not restricted to join homomorphisms; it is not a measurement of any real edge.

`additive: true` remains available per edge as an EXPLICIT declaration. Nothing checks that a declared-additive edge really is additive — that is a per-edge proof obligation like every other narrowing.
attrs.evidence: GPT-5.6's second mathematical finding on R7.3. A per-kind table computes T({a,b}) as T({a}) ∪ T({b}), which makes every representable transfer a JOIN HOMOMORPHISM — but an arbitrary monotone T : P(K) → P(K) need not preserve joins, and two defects can be synergistic. R7.3's notation could not express that without over-approximating a singleton, and it made the assumption silently. GPT-5.6 offered (A) assume or prove additivity or (B) multi-kind antecedents, and preferred B; B IS NOW THE DEFAULT and A is an explicit per-edge declaration rather than a property of the notation. Rules match an input set EXACTLY; an unmatched input on a non-additive edge is ⊤. P(kinds) is finite at 2^5 = 32, so a complete table is enumerable and no additivity assumption is forced on anyone. Control edge E6: T({correctness}) = {correctness}, T({confidentiality}) = {confidentiality}, and T({correctness, confidentiality}) = {correctness, confidentiality, provenance} — a wrong extraction AND a leak together make the audit trail misdescribe what happened, which neither produces alone. CORRECTED AT R7.5, AND GPT-5.6 RULED THIS CLAIM SHOULD NOT BE REFUTED FOR IT. R7.4’s evidence ended with a sentence about a monotonicity gate that did not establish what it said: the gate compared AUTHORED RULES to each other, and the executable transformer has semantics the rule table does not contain — every unmatched input falls through to ⊤, and those fallback points are part of T. GPT-5.6’s mutant `{authority,provenance} → ∅` on E6 makes the actual function non-monotone while the gate printed `✓ every declared rule set is MONOTONE` and exited 0. The PROPOSITION of this claim — that the representation can express a synergistic monotone transfer — is untouched and still demonstrated; what was false was one supporting assertion about a different check. Monotonicity is now IMPACT-TRANSFER-TOTAL-MONOTONE, enumerated over the executable.
